entries.look: Flat-colour style, ambiguous ancient Indian landscape with layered depth: sky, distant hills, mid-ground trees, foreground grass/rocks. No specific architectural or cultural markers.
Middle-aged Brahmin householder, wearing traditional dhoti and upavita (sacred thread), calm demeanor, overseeing food preparation.

Adult male, dark complexion, seated cross-legged on road, wearing only a worn bandi (old cloth wrapper) over shoulders, body smeared with ash? (not stated), hair matted? (not stated), gaze fixed at nose tip, serene face, aura of tapobal like morning sun.
Traditional Brahmin house entrance with doorway, steps leading to road, courtyard visible inside with cooking vessels, morning light.
Dirt road in front of house, scattered used leaf plates (पत्रावळी) with food remnants, rice grains visible.
Dried leaf plates (पत्रावळी), browned, some folded, scattered haphazardly, with visible rice grains and food residue.
A simple wrapper made of old, faded cloth, draped over shoulders, rough texture.
Individual white rice grain, resting on leaf plate surface.
Middle-aged man, traditional Marathi attire (dhoti, kurta), walking with a calm demeanor, slight smile
Middle-aged man, similar traditional attire, perhaps with a turban, walking beside Bankatlal
Dusty rural road bordered by fields and occasional trees, clear sky
Middle-aged Marathi man, wearing white dhoti and uparna, tilak on forehead, graying beard, wise but expressive face
Elderly Marathi man, white dhoti and shawl, clean-shaven, gentle eyes, seated posture
Yogiraj in early 30s, athletic build, wearing only kaupina, smeared with vibhuti, long matted hair, serene countenance
Ancient stone temple courtyard with carved pillars, tulsi vrindavan in center, banyan tree shade, worn stone flooring
Middle-aged male, dark complexion, wearing simple white dhoti and upavastra, rudraksha mala, long matted hair tied in a knot, serene face with slight smile, eyes half-closed
Middle-aged male, Brahmin attire: white dhoti, angavastram, shaved head with sikha, tilak on forehead, gentle face, slight beard
Older male, simple villager clothes: worn dhoti, bare chest, rudraksha beads, weathered face, folded hands
Open ground near a stone well, scattered neem and banyan trees, dry cracked earth, well with stone parapet, no water visible
Small spherical gourd with narrow neck, dried brown surface, carried by a string loop, empty
Generic cow, standing at trough, drinking.
Generic goat, standing at trough, drinking.
Stone well with a nearby rectangular stone trough filled with water, surrounded by dry ground and sparse trees.
Brass lota (traditional water pot) with narrow neck, filled with clear water.
Water in lota infused with khus (vetiver) giving a faint greenish tint and aromatic quality.
Middle-aged male, waist-length matted hair, full beard, wearing simple saffron robe, rudraksha beads, serene yet commanding presence
Adult male, simple cotton dhoti, bare chest, shaved head with small tuft, hands folded in reverence
Adult male, simple cotton dhoti, bare chest, shaved head with small tuft, hands folded in reverence
Dense forest clearing with packed earth ground, surrounded by tall sal trees, dappled sunlight, distant bird calls implied
